caption: The shell stays in D1 (uid 1000) with notes.txt read/write and passwd read/execute but no access to /etc/shadow. After exec of setuid root passwd, the child runs in D2 (uid 0) and can write /etc/shadow; the exec records saved uid 1000 so the program can call setuid(1000) to drop back, but the parent shell never left D1.

spec.title: Domain switch on exec of setuid passwd
spec.aria: A shell in D1 (uid 1000) has read/write on notes.txt, read/execute on passwd, and no access to /etc/shadow. It forks a child that execs setuid root passwd; the exec records saved uid 1000, and the child runs in D2 (uid 0) with read/write on /etc/shadow and root rights on all files. When the child exits, the shell is still in D1.
